Definition
[d'Alembert's formula]

\group Wave Equation

For $g,h:\R \to \R $, d'Alembert's solution is \[ u(x,t):=\frac12[g(x+t)+g(x-t)] +\frac12\int _{x-t}^{x+t}h(y)\, dy. \]
